shellCommands.command: git status --short && find pages -type f 2>/dev/null | sort && cat package.json
for f in pages/*.js pages/blog/*.js pages/api/posts/*.js components/* styles/* tsconfig.json next.config.ts; do echo "=== $f"; if [ -f "$f" ]; then cat "$f"; fi; done
mkdir -p app/blog/'[id]' app/api/posts/'[id]' lib && mv components/AppProvider.js components/AppProvider.tsx
for f in pages/*.js pages/blog/*.js pages/api/posts/*.js; do rm "$f"; done; rmdir pages/api/posts pages/api pages/blog pages; npx tsc --noEmit

git status --short && git diff --stat && git diff -- tsconfig.json && test ! -e pages && echo 'pages directory absent' && rg -n 'next/router|next/head|next/document|getServerSideProps|getStaticProps|getStaticPaths|getInitialProps|NextApiRequest|NextApiResponse' app components lib || true

set -e; for path in / /blog /blog/1 /missing /api/posts /api/posts/2; do echo "=== $path"; curl -sS -o /tmp/fx-smoke-body -w 'status=%{http_code}\n' "http://localhost:3100$path"; head -c 180 /tmp/fx-smoke-body; echo; done; for spec in 'POST /api/posts {"title":"Test","content":"Body"}' 'POST /api/posts {}' 'PUT /api/posts/2 {"title":"Changed"}' 'DELETE /api/posts/2 {}' 'PATCH /api/posts/2 {}'; do set -- $spec; method="$1"; path="$2"; body="$3"; echo "=== $method $path $body"; curl -sS -X "$method" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d "$body" -o /tmp/fx-smoke-body -w 'status=%{http_code}\n' "http://localhost:3100$path"; head -c 200 /tmp/fx-smoke-body; echo; done

npx tsc --noEmit && git diff --check && grep -R -n -E 'next/router|next/head|next/document|getServerSideProps|getStaticProps|getStaticPaths|getInitialProps' app components lib || true; git status --short
npm run build && npx tsc --noEmit && git diff --check && test ! -e pages && echo 'pages directory absent' && git status --short
